IC-HMRC.title: IC-HMRC (IntellixCore)
IC-HMRC.description: HMRC's internal manuals (UK tax guidance) as a navigable map: whole chapters in HMRC's reading order, cross-references, the legislation and cases each section rests on, and what HMRC changed since a date. Read-only; OAuth.

IC-CaseLaw.description: UK tax case law as a citation graph (First-tier and Upper Tribunal tax decisions and judgments naming HMRC), joined to HMRC's manuals and to UK legislation with its version history; judgments read live from The National Archives. Read-only; OAuth.
